records.label: Body and physical well-being
records.description: Resources and conditions that sustain the body.

records.label: Basic sustenance
records.description: What the body requires to stay nourished and sheltered.

records.label: Air
records.description: Access to air that is safe and comfortable to breathe.
recognition_cues: I need to breathe more easily.
The air around me feels difficult to breathe.

records.label: Food
records.description: Enough nourishing food to sustain the body.
recognition_cues: I have not had enough to eat.
I need food that sustains me.

records.label: Water
records.description: Enough safe drinking water to stay hydrated.
recognition_cues: I need something to drink.
I have not been able to get enough water.

records.label: Shelter
records.description: A place that protects the body from exposure and supports everyday living.
recognition_cues: I need somewhere protected to stay.
I need a place where I can live.

records.label: Rest and recovery
records.description: Pausing effort and restoring physical resources.

records.label: Sleep
records.description: Enough restorative sleep for the body and mind.
recognition_cues: I need an uninterrupted night's sleep.
I am not getting enough sleep.

records.label: Rest
records.description: Relief from effort and demands, including while awake.
recognition_cues: I need to stop for a while.
I need time without another demand.

records.label: Movement and bodily connection
records.description: Opportunities for movement and wanted bodily connection.

records.label: Movement
records.description: Opportunities to move the body in ways that suit its abilities and condition.
recognition_cues: My body needs some movement.
I need a change from staying still.

records.label: Touch
records.description: Physical contact that is wanted, comfortable, and freely agreed to.
recognition_cues: I miss wanted physical contact.
I would like comforting touch that feels right to me.

records.label: Sexual expression
records.description: Room for wanted sexual experience or expression, with consent and respect for everyone involved.
recognition_cues: I miss a part of my sexual life.
I want room for sexuality on terms that feel right to me.

records.label: Safety and stability
records.description: Protection from harm and a dependable basis for living.

records.label: Protection from harm
records.description: Physical and relational conditions in which vulnerability can be protected.

records.label: Physical safety
records.description: Protection from physical harm and dangerous conditions.
recognition_cues: I need protection from harm.
I cannot relax while there is a physical threat.

records.label: Emotional safety
records.description: Conditions in which feelings and vulnerability can be expressed without humiliation, intimidation, or retaliation.
recognition_cues: I need to be able to speak without being humiliated.
I want to show uncertainty without being threatened.

records.label: Reliability and continuity
records.description: Enough steadiness to make plans and depend on what matters.

records.label: Stability
records.description: Continuity in important living conditions, resources, or relationships.
recognition_cues: Too many foundations of my life are shifting.
I need something dependable to build on.

records.label: Predictability
records.description: Enough consistency and information to anticipate what is likely to happen.
recognition_cues: I need a clearer sense of what to expect.
The constant changes are hard to plan around.

records.label: Trust
records.description: Confidence that another person or arrangement is sufficiently honest, reliable, and considerate.
recognition_cues: I need to know whether I can rely on this.
I want agreements that are followed through.

records.label: Dignity and fair treatment
records.description: Conditions in which people receive respect and equitable consideration.

records.label: Respect
records.description: Being treated by others as a person whose dignity, perspective, and boundaries deserve consideration.
recognition_cues: I need to be treated with basic respect.
I want my boundaries and perspective to count.

records.label: Fairness
records.description: Equitable consideration of people and their circumstances in access, decisions, and treatment.
recognition_cues: I need a fair share of consideration.
I want decisions to take our different circumstances into account.

records.label: Connection and belonging
records.description: Being with others in ways that offer recognition, care, and mutual involvement.

records.label: Having a place with others
records.description: Being welcomed into relationships and shared life.

records.label: Belonging
records.description: A felt sense of having a place among other people.
recognition_cues: I want to feel that I have a place here.
I miss being part of something with others.

records.label: Acceptance
records.description: Being received as a person without having to hide or earn basic welcome.
recognition_cues: I want to be welcome as I am.
I need room for parts of me that feel hard to show.

records.label: Inclusion and participation
records.description: Having access to shared spaces, activities, and decisions, with opportunities to take an active part and influence what happens.
recognition_cues: I want to be included in what is happening.
I need a way to take part and influence what we do together.

records.label: Companionship
records.description: Having company and shared everyday experience.
recognition_cues: I miss having someone alongside me.
I would like company in ordinary moments.

records.label: Community
records.description: Connection with a wider network of people who share involvement and mutual concern.
recognition_cues: I miss a wider circle of people.
I want relationships that connect me to a community.

records.label: Being understood
records.description: Having one's experience noticed, heard, and met with understanding.

records.label: Empathy
records.description: Having feelings and experience met with an effort to understand them from one's own perspective.
recognition_cues: I want someone to understand what this is like for me.
I need understanding before advice.

records.label: Being heard
records.description: Having attention given to what one is trying to communicate.
recognition_cues: I need someone to listen to what I am saying.
I want my perspective to be taken in.

records.label: Being seen and known
records.description: Being recognized as a particular person with a life and experience of one's own.
recognition_cues: I want someone to notice what I am carrying.
I miss being known beyond the role I fill.

records.label: Care and closeness
records.description: Giving and receiving warmth, practical care, and close connection.

records.label: Affection
records.description: Expressions of warmth and fondness that feel welcome.
recognition_cues: I miss warmth between us.
I want affection that feels natural and welcome.

records.label: Intimacy
records.description: Mutually wanted closeness in which something personal can be shared and received.
recognition_cues: I miss feeling close enough to share something personal.
I want a deeper connection that we both welcome.

records.label: Care
records.description: Having well-being matter enough to receive attention and nurturing.
recognition_cues: I need gentleness with what I am going through.
I want my well-being to matter in how I am treated.

records.label: Support
records.description: Help, encouragement, or shared effort when a burden is difficult to carry alone.
recognition_cues: I need help carrying this.
I want someone in my corner while I try.

records.label: Reciprocity
records.description: A relationship in which giving, receiving, and consideration can move in both directions.
recognition_cues: I need care to flow both ways.
I want my needs considered alongside theirs.

records.label: Autonomy and freedom
records.description: Having a meaningful say in one's life, actions, and personal space.

records.label: Choice and agency
records.description: Being able to influence decisions and act with voluntary participation.

records.label: Choice
records.description: Having meaningful options and a say in decisions, including being able to agree, decline, or change one's mind without coercion.
recognition_cues: I need a real say in this decision.
I need to be able to say no or change my mind without being pressured.

records.label: Freedom
records.description: Room to act and live without unnecessary external restrictions on movement, activity, or ways of living.
recognition_cues: I need room to live and move without unnecessary restrictions.
I want fewer external barriers to the life I want to lead.

records.label: Independence
records.description: Being able to act and manage aspects of life without unwanted dependence or control.
recognition_cues: I want to do more of this on my own terms.
I need less dependence on someone else's permission.

records.label: Personal space and flexibility
records.description: Room for boundaries, time alone, and unplanned action.

records.label: Privacy
records.description: Control over access to personal information, experiences, and parts of one's life.
recognition_cues: I need some things to remain private.
I want a say in who knows this about me.

records.label: Personal space
records.description: Enough physical or psychological room to maintain comfortable boundaries.
recognition_cues: I need more room around me.
I need some distance from other people's demands.

records.label: Solitude
records.description: Time in one's own company, without an obligation to interact.
recognition_cues: I need some time by myself.
I want a pause from social interaction.

records.label: Spontaneity
records.description: Room to respond to the moment without everything being planned or prescribed.
recognition_cues: I want space for something unplanned.
I need room to follow an impulse that matters to me.

records.label: Authenticity and expression
records.description: Living and communicating in a way that fits one's experience and values.

records.label: Being true to oneself
records.description: Alignment between experience, values, and action.

records.label: Authenticity
records.description: Room to be and act as oneself rather than maintain an unwanted performance.
recognition_cues: I want to stop pretending to be someone else.
I need room for how I actually feel.

records.label: Integrity
records.description: Acting in ways one can stand behind in relation to one's values and commitments.
recognition_cues: I want my actions to fit what I believe matters.
I need to be able to stand behind this choice.

records.label: Self-respect
records.description: Treating oneself as someone whose dignity and boundaries matter.
recognition_cues: I want to act in a way that respects me too.
I need to take my own boundaries seriously.

records.label: Speaking and expressing
records.description: Making one's experience available through words or other forms.

records.label: Self-expression
records.description: Opportunities to give form to ideas, feelings, identity, or experience.
recognition_cues: I have something in me that needs expression.
I want a way to communicate what words alone do not capture.

records.label: Honesty
records.description: Communication that can be truthful about relevant experience, intentions, and circumstances.
recognition_cues: I need a more truthful conversation.
I want to know where we actually stand.

records.label: Understanding and growth
records.description: Making sense of experience, developing capabilities, and exploring possibilities.

records.label: Making sense of things
records.description: Enough attention and understanding to orient oneself.

records.label: Clarity
records.description: Information and communication that are specific and unambiguous enough to know what is happening, meant, or expected.
recognition_cues: I need to know exactly what is being asked.
I need clearer information about what happens next.

records.label: Understanding
records.description: Making sense of how or why something works, happens, or connects with other experience.
recognition_cues: I know what happened, but I want to understand why.
I need an explanation of how the parts fit together.

records.label: Awareness and presence
records.description: Enough contact with the present experience to notice what is happening within and around oneself.
recognition_cues: I need time to notice what is happening in me.
I want to be more present for this experience.

records.label: Learning and capability
records.description: Developing and using abilities in ways that make a difference.

records.label: Learning and growth
records.description: Opportunities to develop new understanding, skills, or ways of responding over time.
recognition_cues: I want opportunities to keep learning.
I need room to develop beyond what I can already do.

records.label: Competence
records.description: Having and being able to use the abilities needed to engage with something that matters.
recognition_cues: I need to feel capable of handling what this situation asks of me.
I want to be able to use my abilities successfully.

records.label: Challenge
records.description: Engagement that stretches one's abilities at a meaningful and workable level.
recognition_cues: I want something that stretches me.
I need more than repeating what I already know.

records.label: Effectiveness
records.description: Being able to influence outcomes through one's efforts.
recognition_cues: I need my effort to make a difference.
I want a way to influence what happens next.

records.label: Discovery and invention
records.description: Encountering possibilities and creating something new.

records.label: Discovery
records.description: Opportunities to encounter and explore something not yet known.
recognition_cues: I want to explore something unfamiliar.
I need room to follow my curiosity.

records.label: Creativity
records.description: Room to imagine, combine, and make things in new or personally meaningful ways.
recognition_cues: I want space to make something my own.
I need room to try a different approach.

records.label: Stimulation
records.description: Enough interest, variety, or sensory and intellectual engagement.
recognition_cues: I need something that engages my attention.
I miss variety in what I encounter.

records.label: Meaning and contribution
records.description: A sense of significance, direction, and participation in what matters.

records.label: Direction and significance
records.description: Having reasons to engage and a sense that one's life matters.

records.label: Purpose
records.description: A sense of direction connected to something worth pursuing.
recognition_cues: I want a clearer sense of what this is for.
I need a direction that matters to me.

records.label: Hope
records.description: A sense that worthwhile possibilities remain open.
recognition_cues: I need something worthwhile to look toward.
I want to see possibilities beyond the present difficulty.

records.label: Mattering
records.description: A sense that one's existence and experience have significance.
recognition_cues: I want to feel that my presence matters.
I need my experience to count for something.

records.label: Taking part and contributing
records.description: Being involved in shared activity with dignity and influence.

records.label: Contribution
records.description: Opportunities to give something that supports life, people, or a valued undertaking.
recognition_cues: I want something I can offer to be useful.
I need a way to contribute to what matters to me.

records.label: Cooperation
records.description: Working with others toward something shared, with enough coordination and mutual consideration.
recognition_cues: I want us to work with each other.
I need shared effort rather than carrying separate struggles.

records.label: Appreciation
records.description: Having effort, qualities, or contributions noticed and valued.
recognition_cues: I want the effort I put in to be noticed.
I need acknowledgment of what I have contributed.

records.label: Making room for life events
records.description: Acknowledging what has mattered through joy, change, and loss.

records.label: Celebration
records.description: Room to recognize and enjoy something valued, achieved, or received.
recognition_cues: I want to pause and recognize this good thing.
I need room to enjoy what we have accomplished.

records.label: Mourning
records.description: Time and space to acknowledge loss and its significance.
recognition_cues: I need room for what I have lost.
I do not want to move on before acknowledging what mattered.

records.label: Play, beauty, and harmony
records.description: Enjoyment, renewal, and a sense of fit with one's surroundings.

records.label: Play and enjoyment
records.description: Engaging with pleasure and lightness without needing every moment to be productive.

records.label: Play
records.description: Room for freely engaging, experimenting, or enjoying an activity for its own sake.
recognition_cues: I want time that does not have to achieve something.
I need room to play and experiment.

records.label: Joy
records.description: Opportunities to experience and share delight and pleasure.
recognition_cues: I miss moments of delight.
I want room to enjoy being alive.

records.label: Humor
records.description: Room for laughter, lightness, and a playful view of experience.
recognition_cues: I need some lightness in the middle of this.
I miss being able to laugh together.

records.label: Ease and peaceful surroundings
records.description: Conditions that allow less strain, friction, and competing demand.

records.label: Peace
records.description: Conditions with less conflict, threat, or disturbance.
recognition_cues: I need a stretch without conflict.
I want quieter conditions in which to settle.

records.label: Ease
records.description: Being able to engage or rest without excessive strain and friction.
recognition_cues: I need this to take less effort.
I want a little more ease in my day.

records.label: Order
records.description: Enough organization and coherence to navigate one's surroundings and activities.
recognition_cues: I need things arranged so I can find my way.
I want enough structure to reduce unnecessary confusion.

records.label: Beauty and wider connection
records.description: Encountering beauty, inspiration, and connection beyond immediate tasks.

records.label: Beauty
records.description: Contact with qualities of form, sound, movement, or experience that feel beautiful.
recognition_cues: I miss being around things I find beautiful.
I want beauty in the spaces I inhabit.

records.label: Inspiration
records.description: Contact with something that opens imagination, energy, or a sense of possibility.
recognition_cues: I need something that sparks my imagination.
I miss contact with what moves me.

records.label: Connection with something larger
records.description: A sense of participation in a wider whole, such as nature, humanity, life, or a spiritual tradition.
recognition_cues: I want to feel connected beyond my immediate concerns.
I miss a sense of belonging to a larger whole.
